items.asset: Auth/session plumbing (middleware.ts + lib/supabase/*, requireVerifiedUser/loadMemberships per-page guards, notifySessionExpired singleton, authActions)
items.reason: Wrong: authority is stale-JWT-claims-only with no revocation (a removed/demoted member keeps full read+write power until token expiry — confirmed critical, and the claims hook fails open), per-route auth is unenforced convention with no central guard, and the session-expiry signal is a Node module-level singleton whose server-side use is a documented cross-user leak hazard. Rebuilt plumbing must implement the chosen revocation model (session-epoch claim or live-membership resolution + admin sign-out on remove/demote/suspend), an enforced route-guard layer, and per-request session-expiry signaling. Keep the session-JWT-to-PostgREST data-plane shape and the defense-in-depth RSC-guard habit.
items.evidence: GAP1-4 (CONFIRMED critical); dashboard-map.md §1, §7 note 11; hydrateTranscript.ts:78-85 guard
